Key Features

Built For Audio Enthusiasts

Loaded with powerful customization, synchronized lyrics, lossless tuning, and seamless account synchronization.

Live Synced Lyrics & AI Translation

Sing along with Apple-style synchronized lyrics. Translate foreign lyrics instantly using real-time AI intelligence and Romanization (Furigana, Pinyin, Hangul).

10-Band Parametric Equalizer

Fine-tune your sound with a 10-band parametric EQ, headphone calibration profiles (4,000+ presets), loudness normalization, and crossfade.

High-Quality Audio & Offline Cache

Stream music from YouTube Music at maximum quality, cache tracks for offline listening, skip silences automatically, and set sleep timers.

Material 3 Themes & Pure Black

Tailor your player with Light, Dark, Pure OLED Pitch Black, dynamic wallpaper accent colors, and 19 preset color schemes.

Listen Together Rooms

Host virtual rooms with friends. Synchronize playback, track skipping, and queue management live in real time.

YouTube Music Library Sync

Sign in to sync your playlists, liked songs, history, recommendations, and search across YouTube Music seamlessly.
